'''Turg''' was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] born approximately [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. He joined the Tribe's [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]], becoming a crewmember of the ''[[Starstalker]]'' under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vyn Holpur]]. He took part in the [[Violation|attempt]] to acquire samples of [[wintrium]] from the [[Fountain of Ancients]] on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], where he fought and [[Death/Legends|killed]] many [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] guards before several [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] interfered, attacking the ''Starstalker'' and taking the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] captive. Later, Holpur and the rest of the crew, including Turg, were condemned to death for violating the Fountain.
